name.value: The Grist Mill and Gardens at Keremeos

description.value: The Grist Mill and Gardens is a heritage attraction near Keremeos in the Similkameen Valley, operating a historic flour mill surrounded by period gardens. It is currently under new management and transitioning into its 2026 season. The surrounding Similkameen countryside makes it a natural stop on cycling routes through the southern Okanagan.

address.value: 2691 Upper Bench Rd, Keremeos, BC V0X 1N4
